body:
We've been taken through the untold story of Kira & El Gin.

Here we dive into the Egyptian secret resistance in 1919.

This historical Saga will haunt you even after you leave the theatre, where you'll know love, sacrifition, and treason.

Masterfully written, Directed, and acted, this real epic will touch your heart, and test your convictions and beliefs.

Kira & Gin is epic The movie is amazing. I'm so proud that I saw an Egyptian movie is up to this standard. Every single scene is dazzling. I fell in love with all characters and didn't feel that the movie is long. Please go watch it.

Can't believe I saw this level of action and drama in an Egyptian film. I enjoyed the novel so much, yet the movie is different. Its true the movie is long but not boring at all. The directing is extraordinary , sets , clothes. Just perfect.

I waited to watch this movie for a very long time, almost a year, and I did not expect that it would arouse my fascination, amazement, and admiration to this degree. What I watched amazed me and I was stunned by the quality of the performance.!!!

The movie is at the top of magnificence in terms of everything, whether acting, directing, story or soundtrack, everything is really wonderful and amazing.

I advise everyone to watch it, you will enjoy a wonderful Egyptian historical and epic experience, and of course I will put it on top of the list of the best Arab films that I have seen in my life, amazing.!!
Suspenseful, thrilling, brilliantly written, and engaging source material. The fact that it's based on true events makes it even more compelling. A must-see!!
